facts.text: Premium ocean-view rooms look out over Sunny Bay and the South China Sea.
facts.excerpt: private spaces that offer panoramic views of Sunny Bay and the South China Sea through windows

facts.text: The destination has a year-round tropical climate, verdant mountains, white-sand beaches and coral reefs.
facts.excerpt: With its year-round tropical climate, lush verdant mountains, beautiful white-sand beaches and stunning coral reefs

facts.text: Panoramic ocean-view rooms are on high floors with windows stretching from one side of the room to the other.
facts.excerpt: located on high floors, these rooms allow you to enjoy breathtaking ocean views from panoramic windows stretching from one side of the room to the other

facts.text: In panoramic ocean-view rooms, perpendicular mirrored glass on one side extends the view of the ocean and Sunny Bay.
facts.excerpt: These views are further extended by perpendicular mirrored glass on one side, creating a vast view of the ocean and Sunny Bay.

facts.text: Courtyard rooms have a private outdoor garden, a bay window and a marble bathtub.
facts.excerpt: this room features a king-size bed, marble bathtub and bay window and private outdoor garden with ocean views

facts.text: Courtyard ocean-view rooms look onto a coconut grove and the South China Sea.
facts.excerpt: you can enjoy the stunning views of the coconut grove and the South China Sea and feel the sea breeze

facts.text: The villas have a living room with a Chinese fretwork ceiling.
facts.excerpt: each light-filled, high-ceilinged villa features a generously sized living room with an eye-catching Chinese fretwork ceiling

facts.text: The villas have a fully equipped open kitchen and private dining areas inside and outside.
facts.excerpt: a fully equipped open kitchen and private dining areas (both inside and outside)

facts.text: Garden villas have a courtyard, a private pool and a sun deck, with landscaping that provides complete privacy.
facts.excerpt: Outdoors, guests will find a courtyard, a private pool and a sun deck with sunshade deck chairs, and a landscape that provides complete privacy.

facts.text: Lake-view villas include an in-room espresso machine, daily minibar refilling and all-day butler service.
facts.excerpt: Amenities include wireless Internet access, seasonal welcome fruit, daily refilling of the minibar, an in-room espresso machine and all-day butler service.

facts.text: Lake-view villas have balconies with views of the lake, garden and lawn.
facts.excerpt: a pool, and balconies with views of the lake, garden and lawn

facts.text: The resort has family-friendly items available.
facts.excerpt: Also, we have family-friendly items available.

facts.text: Suites have a spacious bathroom with a walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: The suite is luxuriously fitted with a generously spacious bathroom complete with a walk-in shower

facts.text: The hotel says guests could feel as if they had the place to themselves.
facts.excerpt: you could spend an entire holiday at Park Hyatt Sanya Sunny Bay Resort and feel as if you have had the place to yourself
